name: icell8
description: Takara/ICELL8 plate-like full-length single-cell RNA-seq. Public records can require chip/well or sample-manifest interpretation before automatic mapping.
notes: UniScFlow detects ICELL8 metadata and full-length FASTQ layouts, but intentionally stops after download until sample/well identity has been reviewed.

halt_guidance.blocker: ICELL8 is an open platform whose chip/well selection and library design can be full-length, UMI-based, or custom; the valid-well map and application must be reviewed.
required_inputs: CellSelect/valid-well export or equivalent chip/well manifest
ICELL8 application/protocol, barcode/UMI status, read pairing, and strandedness
next_steps: Recover the valid-well/chip map and determine how wells map to GSMs and biological samples.
Confirm whether the library is full-length non-UMI or requires custom barcode/UMI parsing.
For confirmed full-length inputs, prepare the explicit STAR-featureCounts target; otherwise use the application-specific analysis workflow.

recommended_workflows.name: UniScFlow STAR-featureCounts target
recommended_workflows.role: Full-length non-UMI libraries after explicit well-map review

halt_guidance.resume: Use the explicit STAR-featureCounts target only for validated full-length non-UMI ICELL8 inputs with a resolved valid-well map.
